name: find_files
description: Find a file on this computer from how the user describes it, and open it or show it in File Explorer: words from its name, the kind of file (pdf, photo, spreadsheet, video), when it was made or changed (yesterday, last week, March) and where it is (downloads, desktop, documents). Lists the best matches, or opens the clear winner.

query.description: words from the file name or what it is about, e.g. 'invoice', 'resume', 'tax return'; leave out the kind, the time and the folder (they have their own fields)

kind.description: the kind of file if the user said one (a photo is image, a word file is document)

when.description: when the file was made or changed, in the user's words: yesterday, last week, March, 2024, 3 days ago

folder.description: downloads, desktop, documents, pictures, videos or music, only if the user said where

action.description: find lists matches (default); open launches the best one; show reveals it in File Explorer

path.description: internal follow-up only, never set it

examples: find the invoice pdf I downloaded yesterday
open the tax return from last year
show me the spreadsheet in downloads
where did I save the project proposal
find the presentation from last week
not_for: opening an app or a website
files that are not on this computer
